tool_args.rationale: The added slow-horizon observations show response changing from positive at short H to negative near the target horizon, resolving the central ambiguity. Fit the five parameters numerically to all paid rows. The prior execution failures were caused by predict lacking access to fitted state; this implementation stores fitted parameters in module-level state after fit, so predict(row) uses the required API.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: Eight observations include three long-horizon measurements that establish sign reversal; the verified five-parameter law is identifiable and an additional batch is not justified.
The recalled coupled mechanism and observed sink-gradient signatures support retaining the rho term; five-parameter fitting is warranted.
The observed structured short-to-long sign reversal matches endogenous adaptation, not evidence of periodic oscillation.
